# Teasoo SET

> Teasoo SET (Stakeholder Engagement Tracker) is a multi-tenant SaaS by Teasoo
> Consulting that gives organisations one authoritative source of truth for
> stakeholder relationships. Field teams log engagements in seconds; leadership
> gets a live view of risk, sentiment and commitments across the portfolio.

## What it is
Teasoo SET is a web application for logging stakeholder engagements and tracking
risk, sentiment and commitments, with strict database-level multi-tenant isolation.

## Who it is for
Multinational and multi-team organisations whose field teams engage regulators,
government, community and commercial stakeholders, and whose leadership needs live
risk visibility instead of monthly decks.

## Key features
- Central, tiered stakeholder directory (one record per stakeholder)
- Fast engagement logging
- Automatic risk scoring and escalations
- Commitment tracking with reminders
- Leadership portfolio dashboards
- Role-based access enforced in the database

## Access model
Access is by invitation only. Contact Teasoo Consulting to arrange a pilot.

## Company

## Compliance
Built to the EU GDPR and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). Strict
tenant isolation; essential cookies only; no advertising or data sale.
